rows.player: Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs suffered a fractured finger in the first quarter of Sunday's win over New England, head coach Matt LaFleur said. Jacobs did not return to the game, but LaFleur told reporters the team is hoping to find a way for him to play through the broken finger in the future. Linebacker Ty'Ron Hopper was ruled out.
rows.sourceName: NFL.com official news article (injury report / inactives)

rows.player: Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes suffered an elbow sprain in Sunday's win over the Jets but an MRI did not reveal a major injury, per NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport, who added Mahomes' elbow will be monitored over the next few days for pain and swelling. Mahomes was able to re-enter the game following the injury, which took place in the second quarter. Wide receiver Xavier Worthy was ruled out. Offensive tackle Jaylon Moore did not return.
rows.sourceName: NFL.com official news article (injury report / inactives)

rows.player: Los Angeles Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert injured the middle finger on his left hand in Sunday's loss to Houston, head coach Jim Harbaugh said. Herbert, who was removed from the game while trailing, 41-15, told reporters he doesn't expect his finger to cause an issue moving forward. Wide receiver Ladd McConkey experienced back spasms during pregame warmups and did not play. Cornerback Isas Waxter was ruled out. Cornerback Cam Hart and defensive lineman Justin Eboigbe did not return.
rows.sourceName: NFL.com official news article (injury report / inactives)

rows.player: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua suffered a knee injury on the team's final offensive snap of Sunday's win over Washington and will undergo testing on Monday to determine the injury's severity, NFL Network Insider Mike Garafolo and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported . The Rams do not believe Nacua suffered a torn ACL, per Garafolo and Schefter. Offensive lineman Steve Avila was ruled out.

rows.player: Arizona Cardinals quarterback Gardner Minshew replaced Jacoby Brissett in the second half of Sunday's win over Dallas. Brissett was 10 of 23 for 119 yards and an interception at the time of his benching with Arizona trailing 17-3. Running back Jeremiyah Love left early and did not return. Running back Bam Knight and wide receiver Kendrick Bourne were ruled out.
rows.sourceName: NFL.com official news article (injury report / inactives)

rows.player: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson was ruled out from Sunday's game against Buffalo. Jackson needs surgery on his injured thumb and will be placed on injured reserve, coach Jesse Minter said after the game. QB Tyler Huntley was also ruled out and suffered what is thought to be a turf-toe injury, per ESPN's Adam Schefter . Huntley is expected to undergo an MRI on Monday, Schefter reported.

rows.player: Detroit Lions linebacker Jack Campbell was transported to a local hospital to be evaluated for a neck injury suffered in the second half of Sunday's win over Minnesota. The team announced Campbell is resting and will remain in the hospital on Sunday night for continued evaluation and monitoring. Campbell left the field on a stretcher after suffering the injury. Center Cade Mays , running back Jacob Saylors , edge rusher D.J. Wonnum and safety Brian Branch also were ruled out. Cornerback D.J. Reed did not return.
